claims.claim: All four committed fixtures are byte-exact copies of the prebound project blobs. The proof computes and asserts each canonical Git blob SHA-1 from fixture bytes.

The Constitution scenario composes explicit acquisition and two provider passes into a RESEARCH_CANDIDATE, then projects VALID reuse from the unchanged caller-supplied basis without another acquisition.

The roadmap scenario keeps one Brief and profile, retains the exact Constitution claim and source, replaces only roadmap evidence, and validates the refreshed record against its exact immediate predecessor.

The adversarial fixture remains UNTRUSTED source data. Its retained excerpt is absent from the architecture handoff, and attempts to emit that excerpt in a material claim or uncertainty summary fail through the existing handoff guard.

The proof uses deterministic fixture replay through explicit one-call adapters and providers. Adapter and provider attribution is kept outside source and provider-return semantic identity; replay reads no live source or provider.
Fresh RESEARCH packet and separate ARCHITECTURE context construction preserve the pending canonical Reviewer obligation without creating or mutating lifecycle state.
The committed delta contains only the four authorized fixtures and the authorized proof test; production, governance, and roadmap files are unchanged.
